unit.explanation: The unit is individual patients, with 22 total patients evaluated for drug response prediction

platform.explanation: The platform is an optimized vascularized colorectal tumoroid-on-a-chip (organoid-on-a-chip) model

readout.explanation: The readout combines relative vessel density and relative tumoroid diameter to determine prediction of clinical response

direction.explanation: Lower values of relative vessel density and tumoroid diameter below the optimal cutoff indicate clinical sensitivity to the treatment

threshold_rule.explanation: Optimal cutoff values were determined using the Youden index (ROC-optimized) and bootstrap sampling

threshold_timing.explanation: Cutoff values were fitted on the same 22 evaluated patients to optimize classification performance

patient_mapping.explanation: Individual patient data including ID, clinical response, and chip model readouts are available for all 22 patients

regimen_match.explanation: All patients received the FOLFOX + bevacizumab regimen, matching the in vitro drug testing regimen on the chip model

n_units.explanation: The total number of patients evaluated in this accuracy calculation is 22

split.explanation: The model was evaluated on the same cohort used to determine optimal cutoff thresholds, with no independent held-out test set

headline.blocked_reason: Row-level individual patient score and truth pairs are not provided in the available parsed tables; aggregate accuracy value is reported directly in the article text
